alex: Quick sync — need to lock agenda for Wed cross-func engineering/product sync. Proposed: RFC-42 final review, routing design handover, and a short triage slot. Timezones: PT/CEST overlap.
maria: Wed works for me. prefer 10am PT (6pm CEST) — who is agenda owner?
sam: I can own RFC-42 section (10m). I will post a 2-paragraph summary in this thread.
jordan: Can we push the weekly triage to our Ops channel? If it's tiny we can mark it optional.
alex: Good point @jordan — keep triage as optional 10m. Main focus should be RFC decision + rollout gating.
lisa: Heads up I have a hard conflict at 10. Could we do 11am PT instead?
maria: 11am PT works for me too.
alex: OK locking 11am PT. I'll update the invite. Draft agenda below: 
```
1) RFC-42 final review (Sam) - 12m
2) Routing design handover (Maria) - 10m
3) Rollout decision & gating (Jordan) - 8m
4) Optional: quick triage / blockers - 10m
5) Action items & decision logging - 5m
```
alex: Sam, please drop the RFC summary and highlight open decision points in this thread.
sam: Posted: <https://redwood.internal/rfcs/42|RFC-42 summary> — highlights: fallback policy, canary criteria, perf targets (p50/p95), known regression risk w/ quantization.
maria: Adding one decision candidate: prefer fallback to smaller quantized-llama-v2 when median latency > 250ms for 2 consecutive 5-min windows. Thoughts?
jordan: +1 to the fallback rule, but we should set canary success metric: error-rate delta < 0.5% and subjective quality check by product.
lisa: +1 on both, assuming we keep a quick rollback path.
alex: Sounds like tentative consensus. We'll formalize in decision log during the meeting. Action items so far: Sam update RFC with canary steps; infra to reserve 2 nodes for canary; Maria to draft rollout playbook.
jira-bot: Created ticket INF-2987: "Reserve canary nodes for RFC-42 rollout" and assigned to infra-team.
infra-team: noted, will provision the 2 nodes by Mon EOD and update INF-2987.
sam: I'll prepare a 2-slide summary and post before EOD Tue.
alex: Great — I'll update the calendar invite and add metadata: agenda-owner=alex, note-taker=maria. If anything changes, ping me or update the invite. :thumbsup:
